text: Admission Process Admission to the B.Tech program at Sanjivani University is conducted through the centralized admission process governed by the Directorate of Technical Education, Maharashtra. Candidates must have passed HSC with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics as compulsory subjects. Fee Structure The annual tuition fee for the B.Tech program is revised each academic year as per the Fee Regulating Authority notification and is payable in two installments, one at the start of each semester.

Examination Rules Students must maintain a minimum of 75% attendance in each subject to be eligible to sit for the semester end examinations. Any student falling below this threshold must apply for condonation through the department office at least two weeks before the examination schedule is published. Backlog Policy

Backlog Policy Students carrying backlog subjects from previous semesters are permitted to appear for a maximum of two backlog papers alongside their current semester examinations, subject to timetable clashes being resolved by the examination cell. Revaluation Students who wish to apply for revaluation of their answer sheets must submit a written application to the examination department within seven days of the result declaration, along with the prescribed revaluation fee.

Library Timings The central library at Sanjivani University is open from 8:00 AM to 9:00 PM on all working days, Monday through Saturday. On Sundays and public holidays, the library remains open from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM for reading room access only, with book issue and return services suspended. Book Borrowing Policy
